I can pull a sample audit log and bring key-wrap notes by EOD. Also flag: Private deployment onboarding checklist needed.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Automated ticket opened: CS-789 for CoveCare BYOK/HSM requests. Required artifacts: SOC2 Type II, HSM integration doc, and key management diagram. Current ETA: 2 business days for initial security review.

Katie Li: Today: sync with Infra on EU latency SLO, prepare CoveCare one-pager, run LumaPay demo at 13:00 PT. Calendar link: https://cal.link/lumapay-demo-1300 (join if you can).
Matt Reilly: Quick contract note: CoveCare redlined section 9.2 (data processing) — legal asked for our standard reply. @Sarah forwarded the redline. If new obligations appear, might need to scope Dedicated vs Hosted in the commercial term.
Sarah Choi: I'll loop Legal and Product. Marking potential blocker: if 9.2 expands data residency obligations we may require Dedicated ONBOARD.
Devon Patel: No other blockers from my side — waiting on Katie/Ashok/legal.
Sarah Choi: Thanks everyone — please add any follow-ups here. If you have docs, paste links. :thumbsup:
